document.pages: Printed/physical pp.7–10; assignments p.7, compatible bases p.8, Fig.1-1 p.9

modelingNotes: Exact electronic module represented at the documented TM-E15C24-01 (6ES7193-4CB30-0AA0) assembled field interface: eight numbered field clamps and no AUX clamps. Card and base are separately ordered. Verify the installed per-slot pairing before use. Do not add this abstraction and a second full field-clamp representation to the same circuit.
Field assignment: 1=DO0,5=DO1;2/6=L+;3/7=M;4/8=not connected (maximum applied voltage30 VDC). Internal P1=1M and P2=L+ use the exact Figure1-1 designations, not physical field-clamp names.
Exact p.9 block diagram establishes fixed P1–3–7 and P2–2–6 paths; author explicit source jumpers. Neither output is permanently joined to supply or return. Functions do not simulate switching.

Rated load supply 24 VDC from power module. Outputs rated 2 A each, 4 A total per module; signal-1 range 7 mA–2.4 A; signal-0 leakage at most 0.5 mA. Lamp load at most 10 W; resistive switching 100 Hz, inductive 2 Hz at 0.5 H, lamp 10 Hz. Range maxima are not alternative assigned ratings.

P1/P2 require operating supply connectivity; field terminals are application-dependent. Presence checks can be met by internal jumpers and do not prove an external power module or operational backplane.

The electronic card does not own the separate base clamps. Internal operating-supply endpoints are functional interfaces, not an enumeration of mating fingers. Backplane communication/contact inventory and installed per-slot base pairing remain unverified. Compatible A1-base auxiliary clamps are not part of this selected 24-01 arrangement. Preserve partial coverage; no PE, shield or AUX bond is inferred.
